title: Finite cohomological dimension gives derived coproduct compatibility
statement: Let $u:U\to T$ be a quasi-compact and quasi-separated morphism of schemes [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], and let $A$ be a finite commutative coefficient ring. Use the ordinary unbounded derived categories $D(U_{\Et},A)$ and $D(T_{\Et},A)$ of constant-$A$ module sheaves [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], with direct image $u_*$ and its higher right derived functors as in [def-weil-pbc-direct-image]. Suppose that $R^pu_*M=0$ for every etale $A$-module sheaf $M$ and every $p>c$, for a fixed integer $c\geq0$. Then the total right derived functor $Ru_*:D(U_{\Et},A)\to D(T_{\Et},A)$, with the natural derived comparison of [lem-kun-finite-cd-acyclic-complex], preserves every set-indexed coproduct: for every family $(K_s)_{s\in S}$ in $D(U_{\Et},A)$, the canonical map $\bigoplus_{s\in S}Ru_*K_s\to Ru_*(\bigoplus_{s\in S}K_s)$ induced by the coprojections is an isomorphism. No boundedness or constructibility condition is imposed on the $K_s$, and the empty family is included.

proof.text: For I in the coefficient universe, apply the source qcqs higher-direct-image filtered-colimit theorem directly with module coefficients and shape Finset(Discrete I). Its natural single-sheaf/homology identification is the classical rightDerived functor. Each such functor is additive, so preservation of filtered finite partial sums implies preservation of I-indexed coproducts, including the empty coproduct. Lean uses preservesFilteredColimitsOfSize_higherDirectImage, singleFunctorCompRightDerivedFunctorPlusCompHomologyFunctorIso, and preservesColimitsOfShape_discrete_of_preservesColimitsOfShape_finset. No torsion-forgetting comparison is needed.

The source Grothendieck instances for ModuleCat and small-etale sheaves provide the abelian categories and injective resolutions. Direct image is the additive right adjoint lowerStar and hence left exact. Apply the existing finite-dimensional unbounded derived coproduct criterion with d=c and the exact hypothesis hc, using preservation by all classical right derived functors from the preceding step. This proves preservation for every coefficient-universe indexing type.

The derived source category is locally small in the coefficient universe, and the total derived functor is additive. Apply the existing small-nonzero-support universe-extension helper. This extends preservation to every given existing coproduct indexed in the arbitrary universe w, with precisely the canonical cocone. Empty support and zero coefficients are included.
